Mindful-focus tracker prototype: logs sessions, reports weekly focus stats.
Run: python3 app.py add 45 "study"; python3 app.py report

## Roadmap
- coach agent (done): `python3 app.py coach` proposes next session from history
- export CSV, weekly email summary
- Marcus (tutoring) beta: track student focus sessions

`python3 app.py week` prints per-tag minutes and best day.
